scope: Eight predeclared existing-teacher parameter combinations. Fit/select on nine training-family cases at two new resets only, ranking by fewer falls, longer mean survival, then lower joint RMSE. Preserve every search trial's scalar result and transition counts; search states are not retained as a training corpus. Evaluate the unchanged original and train-selected teacher on separate 27-trial training-family audits and nine new canonical trials each, retaining all evaluation transitions. No actor/world-model fitting, test-based parameter selection, learned-policy qualification or hardware authority.
